title: Finally, NRIs Can Stream First: Dhurandhar 2 Hits Netflix Globally After Its Rs 1,800 Crore Rampage
excerpt: Ranveer Singh's record-shattering spy thriller arrives on Netflix internationally on May 15 — before India's JioHotstar release in June.
body:
NRI Bollywood fans, your wait is nearly over.

Ranveer Singh's blockbuster spy thriller *Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge* — which has been dominating Indian screens since March — is finally heading to streaming. And in a rare win for the diaspora, **Netflix is getting the international release first**, dropping the film on **May 15, 2026** for viewers outside India. Indian audiences will have to wait until **June 4-5 for JioHotstar**.

Yes, you read that right. For once, NRIs get to watch before India.

## The Box Office Juggernaut

Before we talk streaming, let's talk numbers — because Dhurandhar 2's theatrical run has been nothing short of historic. The film has amassed nearly **Rs 1,800 crore worldwide**, making it the second Bollywood film ever to approach that milestone after *Dangal*. It has already surpassed *Baahubali 2*'s records in several markets.

In India alone, the film collected over **Rs 1,144 crore net**, while overseas markets — led by North America, Australia, and the UK — contributed over **Rs 423 crore**. Director Aditya Dhar has crossed a cumulative **Rs 2,000 crore** at the global box office with his filmography, an astonishing achievement.

## The OTT Deal That Broke Records

The streaming rights battle for Dhurandhar 2 was fierce. JioHotstar reportedly paid a staggering **Rs 150 crore** for the Indian digital rights — doubling the offer Netflix had on the table. Jio Studios outbid Netflix, which had streamed the original *Dhurandhar*.

But here's the split that matters for NRIs: **Netflix retains international streaming rights**, while JioHotstar holds India. This means diaspora audiences across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia can fire up Netflix and start streaming on May 15.

## The Extended Cut: Raw & Undekha

Both platforms will debut an extended version called **"Raw & Undekha"** — a 3-hour-52-minute cut that restores footage trimmed for the theatrical CBFC certification. The extended version reportedly includes more graphic action sequences and additional character development scenes, running several minutes longer than the theatrical cut.

For fans who saw it in theaters and felt certain scenes ended abruptly, this is your director's vision unleashed.

## Why This Matters for the Diaspora

Dhurandhar 2 follows undercover agent Jaskirat Singh Ranghi (Ranveer Singh) as he navigates a dangerous mission in Pakistan, seeking answers for the 26/11 attacks. It's the kind of visceral, patriotic thriller that packs Indian theaters on opening weekend — and the kind of film NRIs have historically had to wait months to stream.

The Netflix-first international release represents a genuine shift in how Bollywood tentpoles reach global audiences. Rather than a token "world premiere" followed by months of piracy, the film arrives on a mainstream platform while it's still culturally relevant.

## How to Watch

**Outside India (Netflix):** Available from **May 15, 2026**. Search for "Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge" on Netflix. The extended "Raw & Undekha" version will be the default offering.

**In India (JioHotstar):** Premiering **June 4, 2026**, with early access for premium subscribers. The extended cut will be available from day one.

The spy who broke every box office record is about to break your living room too. Clear your evening — at nearly four hours, you'll need it.
